tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions": plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts, and internal hosts are held to the same HTTPS requirement as every other host. This is consistent with the separately recorded decision to keep certificate verification enabled on all builds.
EOF
